evidence.scope: Only this plugin automatic startup activities/highlighting pass factory are suppressed; manual registry and document-event pipeline remain actual production implementations. Whole-plugin startup is covered separately by Driver.

descriptorIsolation.scope: manual owned SDK composition and real events; automatic startup/highlighting excluded equally; real registration validated separately

resourceScope: reachable owned primitive array payload and bounded GC observation; not full retained heap
eventPump: actual SDK one-event context-reset dispatch; 100us requested idle park; cumulative actual cadence retained, no staging readers
scope: actual SDK direct source+calculator excludes factory/document lease lifecycle; execution actual request-to-observed markup; headless ACTIVE, no real focus/paint
real accepted live session; actual command/document multicaster; synchronous hide and first observed correct SDK guide

ownershipDifference: baseline MAIN_EDITOR daemon full-refresh is outside this owned factory fixture; candidate full-refresh and repair are factory-owned
latencyDefinition: SDK beforeRemoved callback to first correct-guide poll; upper bound including polling/dispatch delay, never exclusive repair duration
